## Symptom
A ship to beta goes red on a content assertion although the deploy step was green (run:fixture-org/menuboard/7861204418).

## Root cause
The route was still answered by the deployment from two days before when verify began: `/__version` returned 9b1f7e2 while 5d0c3a9 was being shipped, and each response came back in 35 to 41 ms (raw:20261021T140212Z-3c9d2e71). The provider's log puts the switch 38 s after the deploy command returned (issue:fixture-org/menuboard#41).

## Fix / workaround
Hold verify until `/__version` returns the commit being shipped (issue:fixture-org/menuboard#41).

## How it is caught
The identity mismatch is visible in the failing run itself (raw:20261021T140212Z-3c9d2e71).
